title: Verification: certify bounded formal bit identities by faithful cyclic replay
body:
A finite cyclic replay certifies a fixed formal group-algebra identity when the quotient is injective on its complete exponent support. This proves an explicit mixed-radix sufficient bound and checks two retained fixtures with independent formal and full regular-action engines. Ten unsafe torsion quotients deliberately accept wrong words; faithful rebinding rejects them. This is a verifier-side result, not a new register construction.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d653d1376374653b0d30d2890d903b1a5aa85ab9/research/bit-faithful-finite-address/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
